newsitem.title: USA: Lawter Int'l Q4 net up on cost improvements.
newsitem.headline: Lawter Int'l Q4 net up on cost improvements.

text.p: Lawter International Inc said on Tuesday its improved showing in the fourth quarter ended December 31 was in part the result of lower costs.

The company said net income reached $7.6 million, or $0.17 a share, compared to a loss of $6.0 million, or $0.14 a share, one year ago. Sales were $51.0 million, down from the $51.4 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Lawter said consolidating less efficient plants as part of a restructuring in 1996 helped increase its profitability.
Lawter makes printing inks and equipment.
Its shares closed up 3/8 Tuesday at 12.
